evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp` alongside `test/functional/wallet_sendall.py`.
rationale: Prevents `sendall` from generating consensus-invalid transactions when duplicate outpoints are passed. When duplicate inputs are provided, the RPC creates transactions rejected with `bad-txns-inputs-duplicate` while reporting success and locking UTXOs with negative balance accounting (`nonmempool: -1.0`). While an annoying reliability and balance issue, it requires malformed user input and carries no fund-loss risk.
